This single-story, 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home is approximately 1,020 square feet on about 2.25 acres, with a two-car garage/workshop/loft, RV parking and Tesla charger. The usable acreage offers room to spread out and explore possibilities for outdoor living, hobbies, or animal keeping. New flooring and paint throughout.
